positions.title: Tech Lead
positions.description:
Projects:
Softimage ICE- Interactive Creative Environment
Maya 2017 Time Editor

Responsibilities:
Lead a team of 4-6 software engineers in developing new animation and simulation features in Autodesk Maya, Softimage FaceRobot and Softimage Interactive Creative Environment (ICE). Develop and maintain the software architecture to support the growing design specification. Communicate with product designers and managers to work out and execute development plans. Ensure code quality and performance. Mentor junior developers.

Responsibilities:
Developed C++ modules for scripting engine, AI, simulation on Nintendo DS platform.

projects.title: Autodesk Maya 2017 Time Editor
projects.description:
● Developed the GUI architecture on Qt Model-View concept and Qt Graphics Framework which boosted interactive frame-rate from 10 fps to 80 fps, supported thousands of interactive GUI objects, and reduced complexity in allowing junior developers to develop new features with ease.
● Designed data structures to reduce time-interval look-up cost from O(N) to O(logN).
● Developed data structures for caching expensive query operations.
● Used Static Code Analysis to measure code quality and identify areas for improvement, maintained a good standard of code quality.

projects.title: Autodesk Softimage
projects.description:
● C++ template programming: made extensive use of C++ template to support multiple data types with generic code and exploit compile-time binding.
● Multi-threaded programming: maintained the parallel graph execution system in Softimage ICE; addressed concurrency issues that affected correctness in multi-threaded execution.
● Debugging tools: utilized Microsoft Event Tracing for Windows to build a tracing tool for identifying memory leak culprits
● Alembic geometry caching: developed method of streaming of heavy geometry cache from disk into 3D scene, reduced runtime memory usage significantly.
● Simulation: extended Softimage CrowdFX with new crowd behaviours; redesigned the user-facing blackbox interface with an open customizable one.
